name: Changelog Impact Classification
description: Structured impact, compatibility, migration, action and security flags attached to a Changelog change entry.

fields.description: Diff-compatible structural/semantic impact classification when evidence exists; null means unknown.
Whether the entry is known to be breaking; null means not established by evidence.
Whether a migration is known to be required; null means not established.
Whether customer-site implementation action is known to be required.
Whether NEXT F Admin action is known to be required.
Whether NEXT F API action is known to be required.
Whether NEXT F Customer CMS action is known to be required.
True only when the change is explicitly security-relevant.

relationships.description: Governed by the NEXT F Changelog Standard.
Compatibility classifications reuse Contract Diff impact vocabulary where evidence exists.

validationRules.description: Unknown action, breaking and migration state remains null rather than being guessed.
Non-null compatibilityClassification resolves to the Contract Diff impact vocabulary.
